text: Amongst the novel objects that attracted my attention during my stay in the United States, nothing struck me more forcibly than the general equality of conditions.
zh: 在美国逗留期间，在吸引我注意的新奇事物中，没有什么比普遍的条件平等更让我震惊的了。
chunks: Amongst the novel objects
that attracted my attention during my stay
in the United States,
nothing struck me more forcibly
than the general equality of conditions.

text: The different relations of men became more complicated and more numerous as society gradually became more stable and more civilized.
chunks: The different relations
of men became more complicated
and more numerous
as society gradually became more stable
and more civilized.

text: Or, more frequently, the king permitted the lower orders to enjoy a degree of power, with the intention of repressing the aristocracy.
zh: 或者，更常见的是，国王允许下层阶级享有一定程度的权力，目的是镇压贵族。
chunks: Or, more frequently,
the king permitted the lower orders
to enjoy a degree
of power, with the intention
of repressing the aristocracy.

text: In perusing the pages of our history, we shall scarcely meet with a single great event, in the lapse of seven hundred years, which has not turned to the advantage of equality.
zh: 翻阅我们的历史，七百年来，我们几乎不会遇到任何一件重大事件没有带来平等的好处。
chunks: In perusing the pages of our history,
we shall scarcely meet with a single great event,
in the lapse of seven hundred years,
which has not turned
to the advantage of equality.

text: Is it credible that the democracy which has annihilated the feudal system and vanquished kings will respect the citizen and the capitalist?
zh: 消灭了封建制度、打倒了君王的民主制度，会尊重公民、尊重资本家吗？
chunks: Is it credible
that the democracy
which has annihilated the feudal system
and vanquished kings will respect the citizen
and the capitalist?

text: In no country in Europe has the great social revolution which I have been describing made such rapid progress as in France; but it has always been borne on by chance.
zh: 我所描述的伟大社会革命在欧洲没有一个国家像法国那样取得如此迅速的进展。但它总是偶然发生的。
chunks: In no country
in Europe has the great social revolution
which I have been describing made such rapid progress
as in France; but it has always been borne
on by chance.

text: High as they were placed above the people, the nobles could not but take that calm and benevolent interest in its fate which the shepherd feels towards his flock; and without acknowledging the poor as their equals, they watched over the destiny of those whose welfare Providence had entrusted to their care.
chunks: High as they were placed above the people, the nobles could not
but take that calm and benevolent interest in its fate
which the shepherd feels towards his flock;
and without acknowledging the poor as their equals, they watched
over the destiny of those whose welfare Providence had entrusted to their care.

text: Every individual being in the possession of rights which he is sure to retain, a kind of manly reliance and reciprocal courtesy would arise between all classes, alike removed from pride and meanness.
zh: 每个人都拥有他肯定会保留的权利，所有阶级之间都会产生一种男子气概的依赖和相互的礼貌，同样远离骄傲和卑鄙。
chunks: Every individual being in the possession of rights
which he is sure
to retain, a kind of manly reliance
and reciprocal courtesy would arise between all classes,
alike removed from pride and meanness.

text: The phenomena which the intellectual world presents are not less deplorable.
zh: 知识界所呈现的现象同样令人遗憾。
chunks: The phenomena
which the intellectual world presents are not less deplorable.

text: But men of high and generous characters are now to be met with, whose opinions are at variance with their inclinations, and who praise that servility which they have themselves never known.
zh: 但现在我们会遇到品格高尚、慷慨的人，他们的观点与他们的倾向不一致，他们赞扬他们自己从未了解过的奴性。
chunks: But men of high and generous characters are now
to be met with,
whose opinions are at variance with their inclinations,
and who praise that servility
which they have themselves never known.

text: I confess that in America I saw more than America; I sought the image of democracy itself, with its inclinations, its character, its prejudices, and its passions, in order to learn what we have to fear or to hope from its progress.
chunks: I confess that in America I saw more
than America; I sought the image of democracy itself, with its inclinations,
its character, its prejudices, and its passions, in order
to learn what we have
to fear or to hope from its progress.

text: Here the reader must necessarily believe me upon my word.
zh: 在此，读者必须相信我的话。
chunks: Here the reader must necessarily believe me
upon my word.

text: This book is written to favor no particular views, and in composing it I have entertained no designs of serving or attacking any party; I have undertaken not to see differently, but to look further than parties, and whilst they are busied for the morrow I have turned my thoughts to the Future.
chunks: This book is written to favor no particular views,
and in composing it I have entertained no designs
of serving or attacking any party; I have undertaken not to see differently,
but to look further than parties, and whilst they are busied
for the morrow I have turned my thoughts to the Future.

text: The territory comprehended in the first region descends towards the north with so imperceptible a slope that it may almost be said to form a level plain.
zh: 第一个区域所涵盖的领土向北下降，坡度难以察觉，几乎可以说形成了一个平坦的平原。
chunks: The territory comprehended in the first region descends
towards the north
with so imperceptible a slope
that it may almost be said
to form a level plain.

text: This vast territory, however, forms a single valley, one side of which descends gradually from the rounded summits of the Alleghanies, while the other rises in an uninterrupted course towards the tops of the Rocky Mountains.
zh: 然而，这片广阔的领土形成了一个山谷，其一侧从阿利根尼山脉的圆形山峰逐渐下降，而另一侧则不间断地上升到落基山脉的山顶。
chunks: This vast territory, however, forms a single valley, one side
of which descends gradually from the rounded summits of the Alleghanies,
while the other rises
in an uninterrupted course towards the tops
of the Rocky Mountains.

text: Nowhere have the great convulsions of the globe left more evident traces than in the valley of the Mississippi; the whole aspect of the country shows the powerful effects of water, both by its fertility and by its barrenness.
zh: 全球大地震在密西西比河谷留下的痕迹最为明显。该国的整个面貌都显示出水的强大影响，无论是其肥沃还是贫瘠。
chunks: Nowhere have the great convulsions
of the globe left more evident traces
than in the valley of the Mississippi; the whole aspect
of the country shows the powerful effects
of water, both by its fertility and by its barrenness.

text: Upon this inhospitable coast the first united efforts of human industry were made.
zh: 在这片荒凉的海岸上，人类工业首次联合起来。
chunks: Upon this inhospitable coast the first united efforts
of human industry were made.

text: A turbulent and foggy ocean washed its shores.
zh: 汹涌而雾气弥漫的海洋冲刷着海岸。
chunks: A turbulent
and foggy ocean washed its shores.

text: The depths of these forests were gloomy and obscure, and a thousand rivulets, undirected in their course by human industry, preserved in them a constant moisture.
zh: 这些森林的深处阴暗而晦暗，有上千条小溪，它们的流向没有受到人类工业的引导，但它们却保持着恒定的水分。
chunks: The depths of these forests were gloomy
and obscure, and a thousand rivulets,
undirected in their course
by human industry,
preserved in them a constant moisture.

text: Their skin was reddish brown, their hair long and shining, their lips thin, and their cheekbones very prominent.
chunks: Their skin was reddish brown,
their hair long
and shining,
their lips thin,
and their cheekbones very prominent.

text: The Indian was indebted to no one but himself; his virtues, his vices, and his prejudices were his own work; he had grown up in the wild independence of his nature.
zh: 印第安人不欠任何人的债，只欠他自己。他的美德、他的恶习和他的偏见都是他自己造成的。他是在天性的狂野独立中长大的。
chunks: The Indian was indebted to no one
but himself; his virtues, his vices,
and his prejudices were his own work;
he had grown up
in the wild independence of his nature.

text: The Europeans produced no great impression when they landed upon the shores of North America; their presence engendered neither envy nor fear.
zh: 当欧洲人登陆北美海岸时，并没有给人留下深刻的印象。他们的存在既不引起嫉妒，也不引起恐惧。
chunks: The Europeans produced no great impression
when they landed upon the shores
of North America;
their presence engendered neither envy
nor fear.

text: An obscure tradition which prevailed among the Indians to the north of the Atlantic informs us that these very tribes formerly dwelt on the west side of the Mississippi.
zh: 大西洋以北印第安人中盛行的一个鲜为人知的传统告诉我们，这些部落以前居住在密西西比河西岸。
chunks: An obscure tradition which prevailed
among the Indians to the north
of the Atlantic informs us
that these very tribes formerly dwelt
on the west side of the Mississippi.

text: Although the vast country which we have been describing was inhabited by many indigenous tribes, it may justly be said at the time of its discovery by Europeans to have formed one great desert.
zh: 尽管我们所描述的这片幅员辽阔的国家居住着许多土著部落，但可以公正地说，在欧洲人发现它时，它已经形成了一片大沙漠。
chunks: Although the vast country which we have been describing was inhabited
by many indigenous tribes,
it may justly be said at the time
of its discovery by Europeans
to have formed one great desert.

text: After the birth of a human being his early years are obscurely spent in the toils or pleasures of childhood.
zh: 一个人出生后，他的早年就在童年的辛劳或快乐中默默地度过。
chunks: After the birth
of a human being his early years are obscurely spent
in the toils
or pleasures
of childhood.

text: New World their national characteristics were already completely formed; each of them had a physiognomy of its own; and as they had already attained that stage of civilization at which men are led to study themselves, they have transmitted to us a faithful picture of their opinions, their manners, and their laws.
chunks: New World their national characteristics were already completely formed;
each of them had a physiognomy of its own; and as they had already attained
that stage of civilization at which men are led
to study themselves, they have transmitted to us a faithful picture
of their opinions, their manners, and their laws.

text: The tie of language is perhaps the strongest and the most durable that can unite mankind.
zh: 语言也许是团结人类最牢固、最持久的纽带。
chunks: The tie
of language is perhaps the strongest and the most durable that can unite mankind.

text: It may safely be advanced, that on leaving the mother-country the emigrants had in general no notion of superiority over one another.
zh: 可以放心地提出，在离开祖国时，移民之间一般没有优越感。
chunks: It may safely be advanced,
that on leaving the mother-country the emigrants had
in general no notion
of superiority
over one another.

text: All of them, from their first beginning, seemed destined to witness the growth, not of the aristocratic liberty of their mother-country, but of that freedom of the middle and lower orders of which the history of the world had as yet furnished no complete example.
chunks: All of them, from their first beginning, seemed destined
to witness the growth, not of the aristocratic liberty
of their mother-country, but of that freedom of the middle and lower orders
of which the history of the world had
as yet furnished no complete example.

text: a [ The charter granted by the Crown of England in 1609 stipulated, amongst other conditions, that the adventurers should pay to the Crown a fifth of the produce of all gold and silver mines.
chunks: a [ The charter granted by the Crown of England
in 1609 stipulated, amongst other conditions,
that the adventurers should pay
to the Crown a fifth
of the produce of all gold and silver mines.

text: The large majority of colonies have been first inhabited either by men without education and without resources, driven by their poverty and their misconduct from the land which gave them birth, or by speculators and adventurers greedy of gain.
chunks: The large majority of colonies have been first inhabited either
by men without education and without resources,
driven by their poverty and their misconduct from the land
which gave them birth, or by speculators
and adventurers greedy of gain.

text: The emigrants, or, as they deservedly styled themselves, the Pilgrims, belonged to that English sect the austerity of whose principles had acquired for them the name of Puritans.
zh: 这些移民，或者，正如他们自称的“清教徒”，属于英国的一个教派，其严格的原则为他们赢得了清教徒的称号。
chunks: The emigrants, or, as they deservedly styled themselves,
the Pilgrims, belonged to
that English sect the austerity
of whose principles had acquired
for them the name of Puritans.

text: It is impossible to read this opening paragraph without an involuntary feeling of religious awe; it breathes the very savor of Gospel antiquity.
zh: 读这开头的段落时，不可能不产生一种不由自主的宗教敬畏感。它散发着古代福音的气息。
chunks: It is impossible
to read this opening paragraph
without an involuntary feeling of religious awe;
it breathes the very savor
of Gospel antiquity.

text: h [ This rock is become an object of veneration in the United States.
zh: h [ 这块岩石在美国成为人们崇拜的对象。
chunks: h [ This rock is become an object
of veneration in the United States.

text: In England the stronghold of Puritanism was in the middle classes, and it was from the middle classes that the majority of the emigrants came.
zh: 在英国，清教主义的大本营是中产阶级，而大多数移民也来自中产阶级。
chunks: In England the stronghold of Puritanism was
in the middle classes, and it was
from the middle classes
that the majority
of the emigrants came.

text: The means used by the English Government to people these new domains were of several kinds; the King sometimes appointed a governor of his own choice, who ruled a portion of the New World in the name and under the immediate orders of the Crown; *j this is the colonial system adopted by other countries of Europe.
chunks: The means used by the English Government
to people these new domains were of several kinds;
the King sometimes appointed a governor of his own choice, who ruled a portion
of the New World in the name and under the immediate orders of the Crown;
*j this is the colonial system adopted by other countries of Europe.

text: In 1628 *m a charter of this kind was granted by Charles I to the emigrants who went to form the colony of Massachusetts.
zh: 1628 年，查理一世向前往马萨诸塞州殖民地的移民授予了此类特许状。
chunks: In 1628 *m a charter
of this kind was granted
by Charles I
to the emigrants who went
to form the colony of Massachusetts.

text: This is followed by ten or twelve enactments of the same kind, copied verbatim from the books of Exodus, Leviticus, and Deuteronomy.
chunks: This is followed by ten
or twelve enactments
of the same kind,
copied verbatim from the books
of Exodus, Leviticus, and Deuteronomy.

text: The chief care of the legislators, in this body of penal laws, was the maintenance of orderly conduct and good morals in the community: they constantly invaded the domain of conscience, and there was scarcely a sin which was not subject to magisterial censure.
chunks: The chief care of the legislators, in this body of penal laws,
was the maintenance of orderly conduct and good morals in the community:
they constantly invaded the domain of conscience,
and there was scarcely a sin
which was not subject to magisterial censure.

text: See, for instance, the law which, on September 13, 1644, banished the Anabaptists from the State of Massachusetts.
zh: 例如，参见 1644 年 9 月 13 日将再洗礼派驱逐出马萨诸塞州的法律。
chunks: See, for instance,
the law which,
on September 13, 1644,
banished the Anabaptists
from the State of Massachusetts.

text: b [ In 1641 the General Assembly of Rhode Island unanimously declared that the government of the State was a democracy, and that the power was vested in the body of free citizens, who alone had the right to make the laws and to watch their execution.—Code of 1650, p.
chunks: b [ In 1641 the General Assembly of Rhode Island unanimously declared that the government
of the State was a democracy, and that the power was vested
in the body of free citizens,
who alone had the right to make the laws
and to watch their execution.— Code of 1650, p.

text: The towns named their own magistrates of every kind, rated themselves, and levied their own taxes. *e In the parish of New England the law of representation was not adopted, but the affairs of the community were discussed, as at Athens, in the market-place, by a general assembly of the citizens.
chunks: The towns named their own magistrates of every kind, rated themselves,
and levied their own taxes. *e In the parish of New England the law
of representation was not adopted, but the affairs
of the community were discussed, as at Athens, in the market-place,
by a general assembly of the citizens.

text: On the Continent of Europe, at the beginning of the seventeenth century, absolute monarchy had everywhere triumphed over the ruins of the oligarchical and feudal liberties of the Middle Ages.
zh: 在欧洲大陆，十七世纪初，绝对君主制在各地都战胜了中世纪寡头政治和封建自由的废墟。
chunks: On the Continent of Europe,
at the beginning of the seventeenth century,
absolute monarchy had everywhere triumphed
over the ruins of the oligarchical
and feudal liberties of the Middle Ages.

text: Anglo-American civilization in its true light.
zh: 英美文明的真实面目。
chunks: Anglo-American civilization
in its true light.

text: These two tendencies, apparently so discrepant, are far from conflicting; they advance together, and mutually support each other.
zh: 这两种倾向看似截然不同，但其实并不冲突。他们共同进步，相互支持。
chunks: These two tendencies,
apparently so discrepant,
are far from conflicting;
they advance together,
and mutually support each other.

text: American legislation; and these customs are no less opposed to the tone of society.
zh: 美国立法；而这些习俗同样与社会风气相悖。
chunks: American legislation;
and these customs are no less opposed
to the tone
of society.

text: Yet in America it is the poor who make the law, and they usually reserve the greatest social advantages to themselves.
zh: 然而在美国，制定法律的是穷人，他们通常为自己保留最大的社会优势。
chunks: Yet in America it is the poor
who make the law,
and they usually reserve the greatest social advantages
to themselves.

text: Anglo-Americans In Its Essential Democracy.
zh: 英裔美国人的基本民主。
chunks: Anglo-Americans In Its
Essential Democracy.

text: In most of the States situated to the south-west of the Hudson some great English proprietors had settled, who had imported with them aristocratic principles and the English law of descent.
chunks: In most of the States situated
to the south-west
of the Hudson some great English proprietors had settled,
who had imported with them aristocratic principles
and the English law of descent.

text: They have, moreover, a sure and uniform manner of operating upon society, affecting, as it were, generations yet unborn.
zh: 此外，它们以一种确定而统一的方式对社会起作用，可以说影响着尚未出生的几代人。
chunks: They have, moreover, a sure
and uniform manner of operating
upon society, affecting,
as it were,
generations yet unborn.

text: In virtue of the law of partible inheritance, the death of every proprietor brings about a kind of revolution in property; not only do his possessions change hands, but their very nature is altered, since they are parcelled into shares, which become smaller and smaller at each division.
chunks: In virtue of the law of partible inheritance, the death
of every proprietor brings about a kind of revolution in property;
not only do his possessions change hands, but their very nature is altered,
since they are parcelled into shares, which become smaller
and smaller at each division.

text: A man wishes to perpetuate and immortalize himself, as it were, in his great-grandchildren.
zh: 一个人希望在他的曾孙中永垂不朽，永垂不朽。
chunks: A man wishes
to perpetuate
and immortalize himself,
as it were,
in his great-grandchildren.

text: The small landowner, who has less information, less imagination, and fewer passions than the great one, is generally occupied with the desire of increasing his estate: and it often happens that by inheritance, by marriage, or by the chances of trade, he is gradually furnished with the means.
chunks: The small landowner, who has less information,
less imagination, and fewer passions than the great one,
is generally occupied with the desire of increasing his estate: and it often happens
that by inheritance, by marriage, or by the chances of trade,
he is gradually furnished with the means.

text: At this moment, after a lapse of a little more than sixty years, the aspect of society is totally altered; the families of the great landed proprietors are almost all commingled with the general mass.
zh: 此时此刻，时隔六十多年，社会面貌发生了翻天覆地的变化。大地主的家庭几乎都与普通大众混在一起。
chunks: At this moment, after a lapse
of a little more than sixty years, the aspect
of society is totally altered; the families
of the great landed proprietors are almost all commingled
with the general mass.

text: Scarcely known to one another, the nearest neighbors are ignorant of each other’s history.
zh: 最近的邻居彼此之间几乎不认识，对彼此的历史一无所知。
chunks: Scarcely known
to one another,
the nearest neighbors are ignorant
of each other’s history.

text: Every profession requires an apprenticeship, which limits the time of instruction to the early years of life.
zh: 每个职业都需要学徒期，这将指导时间限制在生命的早期。
chunks: Every profession requires an apprenticeship,
which limits the time
of instruction
to the early years
of life.

text: The gifts of intellect proceed directly from God, and man cannot prevent their unequal distribution.
zh: 智力的恩赐直接来自上帝，人类无法阻止它们的不平等分配。
chunks: The gifts
of intellect proceed directly
from God,
and man cannot prevent their unequal distribution.

text: To conceive of men remaining forever unequal upon one single point, yet equal on all others, is impossible; they must come in the end to be equal upon all.
zh: 想象人们在某一点上永远不平等，但在所有其他方面都平等，这是不可能的。他们最终必须实现人人平等。
chunks: To conceive of men remaining forever unequal
upon one single point,
yet equal on all others,
is impossible; they must come in the end
to be equal upon all.

text: And such a union is not always to be found.
chunks: And such a union is not always
to be found.

text: To the eyes of some it has been represented by the venal suffrages of a few of the satellites of power; to others by the votes of a timid or an interested minority; and some have even discovered it in the silence of a people, on the supposition that the fact of submission established the right of command.
chunks: To the eyes of some it has been represented by the venal suffrages of a few of the satellites
of power; to others by the votes of a timid
or an interested minority; and some have even discovered it
in the silence of a people, on the supposition that the fact
of submission established the right of command.

text: The public functionaries were not universally elected, and the citizens were not all of them electors.
zh: 公职人员不是普遍选举产生的，公民也不是全部选举人。
chunks: The public functionaries were not universally elected,
and the citizens were not all
of them electors.

text: When a nation modifies the elective qualification, it may easily be foreseen that sooner or later that qualification will be entirely abolished.
zh: 当一个国家修改选举资格时，很容易预见到该资格迟早会被完全废除。
chunks: When a nation modifies the elective qualification,
it may easily be foreseen
that sooner
or later
that qualification will be entirely abolished.

text: But nothing of the kind is to be seen in the United States; there society governs itself for itself.
zh: 但在美国却看不到这样的事情。在那里，社会自我管理。
chunks: But nothing of the kind is
to be seen
in the United States;
there society governs itself
for itself.

text: It is therefore necessary to become acquainted with the State in order to possess a clue to the remainder.
zh: 因此，有必要熟悉这个国家，以便掌握其余的线索。
chunks: It is therefore necessary
to become acquainted
with the State in order
to possess a clue
to the remainder.

text: A nation is always able to establish great political assemblies, because it habitually contains a certain number of individuals fitted by their talents, if not by their habits, for the direction of affairs.
zh: 一个国家总是能够建立伟大的政治议会，因为它习惯性地包含一定数量的个人，这些人以其才能（即使不是习惯）来指导事务。
chunks: A nation is always able
to establish great political assemblies,
because it habitually contains a certain number
of individuals fitted by their talents, if not
by their habits, for the direction of affairs.

text: A nation may establish a system of free government, but without the spirit of municipal institutions it cannot have the spirit of liberty.
zh: 一个国家可以建立自由政府制度，但如果没有市政机构的精神，它就不可能有自由的精神。
chunks: A nation may establish a system
of free government,
but without the spirit
of municipal institutions it cannot have the spirit
of liberty.

text: In America the people is a master whose exigencies demand obedience to the utmost limits of possibility.
zh: 在美国，人民是主人，他们的紧急需要要求他们服从最大限度的可能性。
chunks: In America the people is a master
whose exigencies demand obedience to the utmost limits of possibility.

text: c [ Three selectmen are appointed in the small townships, and nine in the large ones.
chunks: c [ Three selectmen are appointed
in the small townships,
and nine
in the large ones.

zh: 每项服务都有其价格，并且根据他们所做的事情按比例获得报酬。
chunks: Every service has its price,
and they are remunerated
in proportion
to what they have done.

chunks: I shall hereafter examine the general influence
which it exercises
on the ordinary actions of life;
I am now speaking
